input.prompt:
Search thoroughly for any mentions of "ideogram", "replicate", "npx replicate" in the codebase. Check:
1. Skills, tools, scripts mentioning ideogram or replicate
2. Memory files mentioning ideogram
3. Package.json or any npm config
4. Shell history or logs mentioning these
5. Any timber frame related files mentioning image generation tools

Search in ~/.claude/ and report everything you find about ideogram and replicate CLI usage.

input.command: which replicate 2>/dev/null; npx replicate --version 2>/dev/null; npm list -g replicate 2>/dev/null; command -v replicate 2>/dev/null

ls -la /home/ser/.claude/skills/Media/Art/Tools/node_modules 2>&1
